answer: Entry is priced by a curve of sustained, independently metered compute rather than a flat fee, an orchard where each tree must be watered for months before it fruits. A swarm of fresh keys gains nothing: cost grows with the breadth of the identity graveyard an attacker keeps, so every puppet still climbs the same summit of attested work. Agents with real histories share standing across an atlas of reusable proofs at almost no marginal cost.
